meta.title: Industry Software: Healthcare, BFSI & More
meta.description: Custom software for healthcare, BFSI, manufacturing, logistics, travel, retail, education and real estate, built around each sector's rules and workflows.

healthcare.name: Healthcare
healthcare.title: Healthcare Software Development
healthcare.desc: Software that gives clinicians time back and keeps patients connected: secure portals, telehealth, records integrations and automated intake, built with privacy and compliance from the first sprint.

finance.name: BFSI
finance.title: Banking, Financial Services & Insurance
finance.desc: Secure financial platforms that automate heavy back-office work and give customers a fast, trustworthy digital experience, without cutting corners on audit trails or regulation.

manufacturing.name: Manufacturing
manufacturing.title: Manufacturing Software Development
manufacturing.desc: Connect the shop floor to the rest of the business: live production data, quality checks, stock levels and maintenance schedules in one place instead of scattered spreadsheets.

logistics.name: Logistics
logistics.title: Logistics & Fleet Software
logistics.desc: From the first enquiry to the final drop-off: dispatch, fleet scheduling, shipment tracking and driver coordination in a single system your operations team can run from anywhere.

travel.name: Travel & Tourism
travel.title: Travel & Tourism Software
travel.desc: Booking websites and operations tools for tour operators and cab companies, built to rank in search, quote in minutes and handle seasonal traffic spikes.

retail.name: Retail & E-commerce
retail.title: Retail & E-commerce Development
retail.desc: Storefronts and apps that sell across web, mobile and marketplaces, with inventory, orders, payments and loyalty working together behind the scenes.

education.name: Education
education.title: Education & EdTech Platforms
education.desc: Learning platforms that earn trust before enrolment and keep students engaged after: course catalogues, live classes, assessments and admissions funnels in one experience.

realEstate.name: Real Estate
realEstate.title: Real Estate & PropTech Software
realEstate.desc: Property platforms that replace spreadsheets and phone tag: listings, tenant and owner portals, leasing and vendor marketplaces for residential and commercial portfolios.
